jobDescription: Cybersecurity Analyst - Detection and Response Description - As the world around us becomes more connected and more digital, there are increased opportunities for fraud and disruption due to cybersecurity attacks.  The need for companies, products, and services to be secure is more important than ever in this constantly changing landscape. Are you passionate about keeping good people safe from bad actors?  We are too!  We are HP Cybersecurity and we are tasked with the security of the HP enterprise.  As HP continues our digital transformation, the work of the cybersecurity professional is never complete and is always interesting.  Come be a part of making a difference with us! The function manages high-volume, multi-channel customer interactions—voice, chat, email, and digital platforms—focused on technical troubleshooting, issue resolution, warranty services, and field support. Operating through a combination of in-house teams and strategic vendor partners across Americas, EMEA, and APJ regions, the organization serves both consumer and enterprise customers. It plays a critical role in driving customer experience outcomes measured through CSAT, NPS, and service quality metrics, while enabling continuous improvement through feedback loops with product, engineering, and supply chain teams.
